caption:
You don't have one mind. You have three — and they're at war.

Which force is running you right now — Tamas, Rajas, or Sattva? Comment it honestly. That's one map of your inner world revealed. There are gods for every other part of you still unnamed — follow Gods of the Mind and we'll meet them all, one at a time, until you see the whole of yourself.
